title: The Bomb-Maker Who Said He Had Blood On His Hands
the_thought: He thought he had built a thing so terrible that using it again would end the world.
hook: In August 1945, the man who built the atomic bomb clasped his hands over his head like a winning boxer.

levels.name: The Short
beats: His weapon had just destroyed two cities, and the crowd was cheering. But something in him had already broken. Weeks later he stood before the President of the United States and said, almost in a whisper, that he felt he had blood on his hands. The President was so disgusted he called him a cry-baby and had him shown the door. He thought he had built a thing so terrible that using it again would end the world. How does the proud father of the bomb become its most haunted enemy? The full story is on this channel.
